regulations.enforcement_body: City of San Diego Development Services Department
regulations.notes: San Diego enacted a tiered STR permit system effective July 2023. Tier 1 (hosted home-sharing, any days) and Tier 2 (primary residence, up to 20 days/year) have unlimited permits. Tier 3 (primary residence, 21-365 days) and Tier 4 (non-primary) have annual caps via lottery. Tier 4 is capped at ~1% of San Diego's total housing units. All permits require annual renewal.
